content.short: Tellor is a decentralized, permissionless oracle protocol enabling smart contracts on Mantle to request and receive any type of real-world data.
content.description: Tellor is a decentralized oracle protocol allowing smart contracts to request and receive any type of data from the real world through a network of staked data reporters who are incentivized to provide accurate information. Unlike curated oracle networks, Tellor is fully permissionless: any data type can be requested by creating a new query specification, making it ideal for niche data needs beyond standard price feeds. Tellor is deployed on Mantle for flexible, permissionless data access.

resources.title: Reporter Rewards Have Fully Moved to Tellor Layer
resources.tldr: Rewards no longer flow through the legacy Ethereum contracts. What reporters still on Tellor 360 must do, and why Tellor now means the Layer chain.

resources.title: Tellor Pull: Fetching Oracle Data On Demand
resources.tldr: An alternative to the default push model: the value is fetched at the moment a user interacts, attested by Tellor and verified inside the same transaction.

resources.title: Introducing the Tellor Operator Dashboard
resources.tldr: Tellor's security rests on validators, reporters and delegators locking TRB. The dashboard lets each estimate their costs and earnings before committing.
